packs.title: 1,500 frequency-selected kanji
packs.description: 375 lessons; components and word-specific readings. Automated curriculum requires Japanese-language review.

attributions.asset: Kanji definitions, source readings and derived teaching sequence
attributions.source: EDRDG KANJIDIC2
attributions.notes: Source snapshot locked in SOURCES.lock.json. Selection and teaching sequence are Kansei adaptations; old JLPT values are not mapped to N1–N5.

attributions.asset: Kanji stroke paths, polylines and component derivations
attributions.source: KanjiVG, Ulrich Apel and contributors
attributions.notes: Resampled into 24-point polylines; canonical forms only, not an exhaustive list of legitimate variants.

packs.title: Vocabulary
packs.description: 1600 priority-marked dictionary words, gated by required characters. Not a proficiency-certified syllabus.

attributions.asset: Derived vocabulary selection, glosses and reading alignment
attributions.source: EDRDG JMdict
attributions.notes: Derived from JMdict; entry sequence IDs retained. No example sentences or full dictionary included.

packs.title: Vocabulary recordings
packs.description: 103 spelling-matched recordings. Coverage incomplete; ambiguous dictionary readings excluded.
